# coreyhaines31/marketingskills Upstream

The marketing skills in this workspace were vendored from the full upstream `coreyhaines31/marketingskills` v2.0 skill pack.

- Upstream: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- Vendored commit: `dc7fea85bfc389140cafa844ff380e180211e46d`
- License: MIT, preserved in `.github/tools/LICENSE`
- Install method: cloned the upstream repository and copied every directory under upstream `skills/` into `.github/skills/` so each skill remains a normal workspace skill at `.github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
- Shared upstream tool documentation was copied to `.github/tools/` because the skill pack references `../../tools/...` from individual skill folders.

Do not move these skills to `.agents/skills/`; `.github/skills/` is Ariadne's canonical committed workspace skill location.
